new_findings.claim: Task aggregate success variance includes between-state difficulty; a fixed-state GRPO group needs within-state outcome variability.
new_findings.counterexample: All states u=0.5 vs half u=0/half u=1: same s=0.5 but mixed-outcome probability at G8 is 127/128 vs 0.

new_findings.claim: Importance correction preserves the fixed surrogate gradient expectation, not its variance or Adam/clipped optimizer update.
new_findings.assumptions: Fixed behavior/evaluation policy; independent complete groups; fixed state distribution; fixed n/group size/loss; finite moments and support.

new_findings.claim: Q-native vs Q-fixed cannot by itself isolate objective change from variance, scale, optimizer and history effects.

optional_baselines.U-qweight: Uniform sampling with q/p weighting; add if making an objective-change explanation. Same expected q surrogate as Q-native only at common fixed policy.
optional_baselines.U-distinct: Uniform subset8 of10 tasks, one group8 each,64rollouts. Inclusion probability0.8; record sampling design separately, do not reuse with-replacement p/q metadata. Add if coverage is a plausible explanation; prefer over degenerate C when all costs equal.

p1_design_amendments.coverage: 128 fixed independent group draws at q=0.02 still leave P(zero task draw)=0.98^128. ESS counted at group level only.

analysis.primary: Q-fixed minus U in p-uniform deployment SR at prechosen common control-call budget including required calibration. Report actual checkpoint cost/slack plus separate GPU/wall time.
analysis.statistical_unit: Independent paired training seed; fixed ten-task estimand; evaluation states/action seeds are nested, not independent training runs.
analysis.initial_report: Every paired difference, mean and range; no equivalence conclusion from nonsignificance or overstated narrow bootstrap CI.
analysis.threshold_origin: Researcher operational choice, not power-derived or publication criterion
analysis.continuation_rule: Consistent positive three-seed direction and mean>=0.03 prioritize independent confirmation; mixed/uncertain results remain inconclusive.

result_branches: State heterogeneity predicts frontier failures: test on new train states at a fixed checkpoint before method expansion.
U-distinct explains gain: prefer simple coverage, avoid complex predictor.
Only Q-native helps: analyze weighting/optimizer before causal attribution.
Interaction gain without wall-time gain: restrict efficiency claim.
No direct signal or inconclusive tiny differences at cap: stop repeated allocator sweeps; alternative reward/state interventions need distinct hypothesis.
Robust important effect after simple controls: new seeds plus one additional suite or checkpoint before broad claims.
n2_r1.publication_assessment: Continue bounded empirical-analysis candidate. Pure allocator novelty and top-tier publication case remain unproven; known identities or one-checkpoint replication are insufficient.
